title: Rice Cooker Lime-Coconut Rice with Cilantro and Black Beans
description: Fragrant coconut rice cooked in a rice cooker with lime, finished with cilantro and black beans for a fresh, simple side or base.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice thoroughly until the water runs clear.
Add rice, coconut milk, water, salt, lime zest, and lime juice to the rice cooker and stir to combine.
Cook on the white rice setting until done.
Fluff the rice with a fork, then top with black beans and cilantro before serving.
